SessionStore persisted the live runtime Session (Netty connection, negotiated Protocol instance, process-local activity timestamp) through a public SPI no implementation could honor durably. SessionStore's contract required implementations to persist the live runtime Session, including its Netty connection and negotiated Protocol instance, and a System.nanoTime() timestamp meaningless outside this JVM's uptime. No implementation could honor that contract; the live session table is now an internal, non-pluggable detail of SessionManager, and SessionEventStore (already persistence-safe) is the only remaining pluggable session-related store
